# vJoy 2.2.2.0 (BrunnerInnovation fork)

`vJoySetup_v2.2.2.0_Win10_Win11.exe` is the unmodified, signed (Brunner Elektronik AG) installer from
https://github.com/BrunnerInnovation/vJoy/releases/tag/v2.2.2.0 - redistributed under the MIT licence
in `LICENSE.txt`.

SHA-256: `ef569a3105cd301b89580f18f60c66b339e95296acf2c0dfcaf4b4bbf8ab68fe`

Version 2.2.x is required: vJoy 2.1.9 gives every DirectInput effect the same effect block index,
which mixes up force-feedback effects.
